seal.statement: The nightly formation-health workflow produces measuring verdicts and a committed trend: an UNKNOWN verdict fails the job loudly and appends nothing, every measuring run (green or red) appends one record to data/formation-health/trend.ndjson and commits it to main with the workflow token, and the release notes, the README claim and the consolidation budget read that committed file; done when three consecutive scheduled records measure.

text: UNKNOWN verdict fails the run and appends nothing (formation-health.js); --metric prints the unmeasured count among the last three records (the probe); formation-health.yml commits data/formation-health/trend.ndjson to main with the workflow token after every scheduled run (contents: write, persist-credentials, rebase-retry push), checkout no longer keeps a runner-local copy. Probe stays red until three scheduled runs measure, so the change is committed directly and the quest lands when the trend proves it.

Independent verifier, two rounds: r1 REJECT on two sibling changes in the same diff (npm next move unauthenticated under trusted publishing; --rows probe green on an unknown name), the formation-health workflow and script themselves approved in r1 (no double commit on the persistent runner, checkout on a branch for schedule/dispatch, gitignore negation chain proven in a scratch repo, UNKNOWN/null guard before append, --metric read-only). r2 APPROVE: next move token-gated via npm_config_//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken (verified against npm 11.7.0 config loading), idempotent on rerun, never backward past a newer prerelease; unknown budget rows unmet.

The trend-record push has not reached main since 2026-09-14: runs 34925405521, 35052200699, 35178550079 and 35303538995 (09-15..09-18) each measured (PASS, FAIL, PASS, FAIL) and each lost its record, because the workflow's push runs the whole pre-push gate on the provisioning runner. Two different causes, both reproduced locally, neither a stale seal. (1) 09-15..09-17 at 3b1fd7877: the gate's static-analysis-postpush stage failed; run-static-audits at 3b1fd7877 with a clean npm ci tree fails audit:guidelines with 197 new literal-guideline violations in scripts/lab/* from the 09-14 home-lab tooling merge, and repository-health on main at 3b1fd7877 concluded failure (ci green). Class: main genuinely red; the gate was right, the data commit was collateral. The red was gone by 8ea49df09 (the runner's own gate passed the static stage there). (2) 09-18 at 8ea49df09: every stage green, then "the gate mutated the exact checkout: M test/shards/impact-graph-seal.json". Reproduction in a clean worktree at 8ea49df09: npm@11.7.0 ci then generate-global-owner-debt-inventory --refresh leaves the seal byte-identical (main's seal is NOT stale; generation is deterministic - identical twice); after the workflow's own `npm install --no-save --package-lock=false @pulumi/pulumi@3.261.0 @pulumi/gcp@9.36.1` (added 187, removed 127, changed 262 packages) the refresh changes resolverStateDigest and snapshotDigest only (source digests unchanged), deterministically. The same install WITHOUT --package-lock=false adds 96 packages, leaves every locked package at its locked version and the seal byte-identical. Class: a deterministic but inappropriate environment rewrite caused by the trend workflow itself - disabling the lockfile re-resolved the whole tree from semver ranges (262 locked packages at other versions, 118 missing; 43 non-dev, among them fastify 5.9.0->5.12.5, @fastify/websocket 11.2.0->11.3.1, pg 8.18.0->8.23.0). Consequence beyond the seal: the nightly driver on the runner (not the GCP nodes, whose image runs npm ci --omit=dev from the lockfile) ran on dependencies the lockfile never named, varying with the registry on each night.

Repair of the recording path, narrow and fail-closed. (a) formation-health.yml installs the Pulumi boundary with --no-save only, so the lockfile governs every other package (the seal cause, and the driver's dependency drift). (b) The trend's owner, scripts/checks/formation-health.js, gains the one predicate for a data-only push: --verify-trend-push <base> <head> (verifyTrendPush) admits base..head only when head descends from base and every commit has one parent and modifies exactly data/formation-health/trend.ndjson in place (100644 both sides, status M, no renames), the old bytes are a prefix of the new, both end on a line boundary, and every appended line is a JSON record with schemaVersion 1, a parseable at, a head and a measuring verdict (UNKNOWN is refused, per non-verdict-never-recorded). Any problem, including a git error, refuses. (c) .githooks/pre-push: a push that requests LAGRANGE_PUSH_DATA_ONLY=formation-trend must be exactly one ref, to main, over an existing remote main, and pass the predicate; otherwise the push is REFUSED - it never falls back to the code gate, so the request cannot carry code; without the request every push takes the gate as before. The workflow's commit step sets the request. (d) New records name their workflow run (run: {id, attempt} from GITHUB_RUN_ID/GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT; null locally). (e) Backfill: the four lost records appended in time order from each run's uploaded artifact (the record the job itself wrote, last line of the artifact's trend.ndjson; head, event=schedule and report timestamp cross-checked against the run), each with run {id, attempt} and backfill {recordedAt, from: artifact name, id and sha256 digest, why}, so none can pass for a new run; no GCP rerun. The 09-13 run (34735728337, FAIL) predates the recording feature and is not backfilled. Tests: formation-health.test.js - the install line may not disable the lockfile; records carry their run; the predicate admits one and two appending commits (a red record included) and refuses source beside the record, the seal alone, a source change reverted later in the push, a rewritten record, a mode change, an UNKNOWN verdict, another schema version, a record with no time or head, an unreadable time, a non-JSON line, a partial line, a --no-ff merge of a pure append, an unrelated history, a zero base and an empty push. pre-push-hook-control-flow.test.js - the owner proves exactly the pushed range and nothing is gated; an owner refusal is a refusal with no fallback; an unknown request, a second ref, a non-main ref, a new main and a manual invocation are refused before anything is proved. Mutations: 16/16 killed (mode, prefix, verdict, torn tail, one-change, ancestor, merge, per-commit, schema, time; hook fallback, ref count, new main, request name). Probe after backfill: 0. The quest is held open until a scheduled run records itself through this path.
